description: This file defines the Coroutine class within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, implementing promise-based asynchronous control flow using generator functions (coroutines). It provides mechanisms to create, manage, and resolve such promises via generator functions, enabling sequential asynchronous operations with less verbosity.

classes.name: Coroutine
classes.description: A class that implements a promise resolved through generator functions, allowing asynchronous code to be written in a sequential, generator-based style.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Coroutine instance from a generator function.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers callbacks to be executed when the promise resolves or rejects.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a callback to handle promise rejection.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks execution until the promise settles and retrieves its value.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise (pending, fulfilled, rejected).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with the given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with the provided reason.

methods.name: nextCoroutine
methods.description: Handles the progression of the generator by converting yielded values into promises and attaching success/failure handlers.

methods.name: _handleSuccess
methods.description: Internal method handling successful completion of a promise yielded by the generator, progressing the generator or resolving the final promise.

methods.name: _handleFailure
methods.description: Internal method handling failure of a yielded promise, forwarding the exception into the generator.
